//why: This file carries SITE facts: which PACS this is, where its data lives, which ports, how to
reach its database and cache. It deliberately carries NO STATE POLICY.
State policy — RULE-FA named switches, TDS behaviour, language, OrgScope, feature toggles —
lives in appsettings.<STATE>.json, generated by build/generate-state-config.py in the L2-R2
workspace and governed by docs/state-variation-doctrine.md, which is LOCKED. A site config
pack that could override state policy would route around that doctrine one PACS at a time,
and the estate would stop being able to say what a state's configuration actually is.
If you find yourself wanting to add a behavioural switch here, it belongs in the state file.
